Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Claus Staal" asked:

> Wasn´t there some sort of ruling regarding the Soul Gemo of Etrius,
> preventing the "new" vampire (bearer being burned and triggering the
> Soul Gem) to come into play until the influence phase or is it just me
> having a temporary melt down??

No, there was no ruling of that sort.

There was a request by victims of the Baron deck that
such be made. No such ruling was made.

You can verify this by reading LSJ's posts, all of which
are collected here:

http://groups.google.com/groups?q=group:rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad+author:vtesrep%40white-wolf.com+OR+author:vtesrep%40wizards.com&num=100&hl=en&scoring=d

or by going here:

http://www.thelasombra.com/rules.htm

and clicking on the appropriate Google link.

Carpe noctem.
